messages:
amanda: Opening a follow-up thread from today’s all-hands about the resilience incident. Shared RCA here: https://redwood.internal/rcas/2026-04-02-backpressure-rootcause. Post questions, clarifications, and who will own items.

jay: Thanks. Two asks: can we get a summary one-pager for execs/customers, and what is the short-term rollback plan if the patch causes regressions? @sree @kelsey

sree: I can draft the rollback/runbook for the patch. Short-term plan is to enable a conservative throttle limiter and revert routing change if p95 error spikes. Ill own the runbook.

kelsey: Ill produce the customer-facing one-pager once security signs off on the sanitized RCA. ETA Monday for the draft.

daren: Ops request: please add a small end-to-end smoke test to catch the retry storm pattern. I can add it to the nightly suite.

lia: Ill add a per-route metric for "retry_loop_detected" and a PagerDuty escalation mapping. Can do a basic dashboard tile by tomorrow AM.

amanda: Repro log snippet (sanitized):
```
2026-04-02T13:14:02Z router: conn reset, route=eu-west, retries=3
2026-04-02T13:14:03Z worker: prefix=false, kv_warm=false
2026-04-02T13:14:03Z router: queued due to backpressure, retry_policy=aggressive
```

prod-bot: note: RCA document updated with timeline v2 by amanda at 2026-04-02T15:00Z :memo:

kelsey: Action owners draft: (1) Patch & canary config  sree + matt; (2) Dashboard & alerting  lia; (3) Smoke tests & CI  daren; (4) Exec/customer summary  kelsey; (5) Runbook updates  sree.

jay: Product question: any customers impacted enough to trigger proactive outreach? If so, who will own comms?

amanda: We flagged two pilot customers. Kelsey will own comms after security approves. If we need to hotfix earlier, product (jay) will coordinate outreach.

ops-bot: scheduled: watch window 1780124160-1780127760 started by lia for the canary rollout :eyes:

sree: Deploy timeline: patch PR today, canary tonight (10% routing), monitor 2h, then ramp if stable. Ill post PR link once ready.

jay: Thanks all. Ill collate these into the all-hands follow-up doc and ping owners individually. If anyone needs help, reply here and Ill reassign.

amanda: Great. Closing when links to PR, runbook, and customer one-pager are in the follow-up doc.
__notes: Single-string thread; messages in chronological order; fields match agents.md requirements.
